fonts.display: 'PP Right', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Electric Indigo
palette.role: Full-bleed hero canvas, section backgrounds, heading text on light surfaces, all primary borders and dividers — the single chromatic color that defines the entire system

palette.name: Patch Orange
palette.role: Filled CTA buttons and active nav markers — the only warm color, reserved exclusively for conversion moments

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, hero reverse text, card surfaces, icon fills — the neutral that makes the indigo vibrate

palette.name: Fog Gray
palette.role: Secondary card surfaces, subtle elevation between cards and canvas

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Tertiary card backgrounds, muted surface layer

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Input backgrounds, hairline borders on light sections, disabled states

palette.name: Gridline
palette.role: Major section dividers, muted heading accents, structural borders on the blue canvas

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary body text, dark card backgrounds, button borders — near-black with a slight warmth
